rows.note: Use 漢堡包 for the savoury roll used for a hamburger or similar sandwich.

example.english: I want to eat a bun.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 sik6 go3 hon3 bou2 baau1

rows.note: Use 屁股 as the ordinary colloquial word for a buttock or the buttocks.

example.english: I hurt my bun when I fell.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dit3 can1 go3 pei3 gu2

rows.note: Use 餐包 as the general word for a small bread roll, including a sweetened one.

example.english: Let's have a bun for breakfast.
example.jyutping: zou2 caan1 sik6 go3 caan1 baau1 laa1

rows.note: Use 髻 for hair rolled up and worn at the back of the head.

example.english: They wore their hair in a bun today.
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zaat3 zo2 go3 gai2
